literal_meaning: কাপড়ে ফোঁড়া বা ছিঁড়া কাটা (to cut a slit or vent in cloth)
figurative_meaning_bn: কথাবার্তার মধ্যে বিদ্রুপাত্মক মন্তব্য করা; খোঁচা দেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To make sarcastic or mocking remarks during conversation; to jab or poke fun at someone
similar_in_english: to take a dig at someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুর সামনে তার স্ত্রীর প্রতি ফোড়ন কাটল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He always cuts in with sarcastic remarks during talks.
She didn't make any jabs at her friend in front of others.
note: The idiom draws from tailoring imagery where a 'phoron' is a deliberate cut for functionality, metaphorically extended to sharp, cutting words in speech.
